scripts.text: I think you have too many items. Let's try it again after you take some out.
scripts.translation: 你带的东西好像太多了，先放下一些再试吧。

scripts.text: You're overweight with items so I don't think we can proceed any further. Challenge me after you've taken some items off.
scripts.translation:
你携带的物品超重了，没法继续。
先卸下一些，再来挑战我吧。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I am Valerie; I help those with abnormalities. I am friends with Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
我是瓦莱丽，专门帮人解决身体异常的问题。
我和瓦尔基里是朋友。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
If both abnormalities disappear then we must start the test over from scratch. What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
如果两种异常都消失了，测试就得从头再来。
你想怎么做？

scripts.text: I don't have any abnormalities
scripts.translation: 我没有异常

scripts.text: I think my body has some abnormalities
scripts.translation: 我觉得我的身体有些异常

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
That's a relief. Then please take care.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
那就好，请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
Are you sure you want to intialize it and start over?
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
你确定要重置，全部从头开始吗？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Yes, I want to start completely over
scripts.translation: 是的，我想完全重新开始

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I understand. I'll see you next time
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
明白了。下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
All items related to the existing conditions will disappear. Are you okay with this?
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
与当前状态相关的物品都会消失，你确定吗？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Yes, I want to start completely over.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想完全重新开始

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I understand. I'll see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
我明白了。下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
It seems that there are a sea of people who seemed to be cursed of not being able to get a significant other after going through with this. Are you still okay with this?
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
听说有不少人做完这件事后，就像中了诅咒一样，再也找不到伴侣。
即便如此，你还要继续吗？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: I still want to intialize.
scripts.translation: 还是要重置

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I understand. I will see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
我明白了。下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
In extreme cases, some become crippled and can get ulcers. Do you still want to intilize former processes?
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
严重的，甚至可能残疾、长溃疡。
你还是要重置之前的进度吗？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Please intilize the former processes
scripts.translation: 请重置之前的进度

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I understand. I will see you next time
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
我明白了。下次再见。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
Please unequip the Magical Stone or Magical Stone Ring and try again.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
请卸下轮回之石或轮回之石戒指后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
Please talk to me after your replace all Magical Stones.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
请更换所有轮回之石后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
You're carrying something that is unnecessary. I will sort it out for you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
你带着不该有的东西，我帮你清理一下。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I don't think you should have any further business with me.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
我想你应该没有别的事要找我了。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
You're carrying big karma- You should erase it.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
你背负着沉重的业障，得把它消除才行。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
Please talk to me again as there could be additional problems.
scripts.translation:
[瓦莱丽]
之后再来找我，我看看是否还有其他问题。

scripts.text:
[Valerie]
I will help clear your problems for you that came from your former attempts.
scripts.translation:

我会帮你解决先前尝试留下的问题。
